title: AgentCheckInResponse
description: The `data` payload of the Response envelope for POST /checkin.

desired.description: Desired state to reconcile against. A command is an order given once — miss it and it is gone; this describes how the device should be, repeated every check-in, so a device that was off catches up by itself. Optional: absent from older servers, ignored by older agents.

kiosk.description: Wanted kiosk, same shape as the `kiosk.enter` payload (KioskApplyPayload). null means no kiosk: a device currently in one must leave it.

policies.description: Wanted toggles, keyed as in `policy.apply` (wifi, bluetooth, camera, …). An absent key means unmanaged — which is not the same as false: 'leave it alone' versus 'turn it off'.

revision.description: Bumped on every configuration save. Equal to the applied revision means nothing to do — this is what stops the kiosk being re-applied on every check-in, which would be visible on screen.
